text:
Type: red heart wall lamp
Use: soft night light and decoration on a wall; children's bedroom, nursery, playroom
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: glossy molded plastic body that glows when lit
Colors: bright cherry red
Shape: plump puffy heart with a soft rounded outline and a center seam, mounts flat on the wall, compact and solid, playful silhouette
Feel: sweet, playful, cheerful, cozy
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, red or pink accents; children's rooms and nurseries
